column1: # STRATO experimental comparison: temperature sensitivity of the release of an intact particle over the registered heating-test temperatures
# label: numerical solution of the stated model; not experimental validation; the comparison with the register is a comparison of release behaviour
# solver: STRATO BTCS five-layer spherical finite difference

# model_limitations: kernel-only start (inventory-matched start node); constant diffusion coefficient per layer evaluated at the test temperature from the first hour (heating ramps are not modelled); no radioactive decay and no fission-product generation in the solver yet; perfect interface contact; absorbing outer surface; one intact particle
column2: no matrix; the model fraction is a fraction of the particle's own inventory

column1: # parameter_source: geometry design AGR1-B-M16 (register rows G-01 G-02 G-03 G-04 G-05); diffusion coefficients chosen by the strato-data selection function (decision 47) for the heating-test phase
column2: that is the rows of register sets C16-T2 and C16-BUF as printed
column3: evaluated at the test temperature (the kernel rows are UO2 surrogates: no UCO measurement exists
column4: decision 40); the class of each coefficient (owner ruling 16) and its phase of use are in the sensitivity file and in the coefficient_sets of comparison.json
